## Activity

River Outreach recorded 27 captures during February 2020. The activity provides a summary of imaging completed at the site during the reporting period. The available capture volume should be considered alongside the image-quality and grading outcomes described below. Any operational matters affecting image collection should continue to be documented through the usual service channels.

## Image quality

Of the 27 captures, 5 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 18.5. The result indicates that image acquisition quality remains an area for monitoring. Staff should continue to follow the established imaging process and record any recurring equipment or camera issues so that they can be reviewed and addressed promptly. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk.

## Grading

There were 2 referable results during February 2020. The median lag for grading was 1 day. This provides an indication of the time between image capture and completion of grading for the reporting period. Results requiring follow-up should continue to be managed in accordance with the applicable clinical and administrative processes. Further review of image quality and grading activity should be undertaken as part of routine site operations.
